summary: A new hire whose manager takes part in the first weeks is far more likely to call the start a success.
realLife: Gallup found employees were about 3.4 times as likely to rate onboarding successful when the manager took an active role.
sources: Gallup, Create an exceptional onboarding journey for new employees: https://www.gallup.com/workplace/353096/create-exceptional-onboarding-journey-new-employees.aspx
inGame: new-coworker event with boss tie; job record start date.

turns.summary: The boss meets the new hire weekly and the newcomer settles.
The boss is busy and the newcomer learns by trial.
A coworker takes the newcomer under a wing instead.
